CNBC | Published Fri, Sep 25 2026 2:38 PM EDT
Microsoft gives Copilot a much-needed overhaul, and the stock deservedly soars

Stocks were higher Friday and headed for a winning week. The strength in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq came despite soaring bond yields. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly reached 5.23% on Friday, a level not seen since mid-June 2007. The surge in yields has been driven by concerns about inflation, which has been stoked by elevated oil prices. While lower Friday and set to break three straight weeks of higher prices, West Texas Intermediate crude is still up nearly 40% since the Iran war started in late February.

Last week, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years... According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market sees a second rate increase by the end of the year, and possibly one more. Bank stocks have lost roughly 4% since the Sept. 16 rate hike...

Microsoft has given its Copilot AI tool a major facelift - and the market likes what it sees, sending shares of the cloud and software giant up more than 4%. Microsoft is the best-performing member of the "Magnificent Seven" in Friday's session.
